signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in with your Google account to manage your team's roster and lineups.
signIn.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
signIn.startFailed: We couldn't start the sign-in. Please try again.

backend.waking: The server is starting up — this can take up to ~30 seconds on our free hosting. Thanks for your patience.
backend.dbPaused: The database is paused (free tier). Ask the app administrator to resume it; saved data is unavailable until then.
backend.down: We can't reach the server right now.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rejected: Some of the entered details were rejected. Please check them and try again.
errors.busy: The server is busy or starting up. Please try again in a moment.
errors.timeout: The server took too long to respond. Please try again.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.serverRejectedFields: The server rejected some of the details. Please check the highlighted fields.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.notFound: That no longer exists. Refresh the page and try again.

validation.tooLong: {{field}} can be at most {{max, number}} characters
validation.capNumber: Enter a cap number from 1 to 15
validation.maxPlayers: A lineup has at most {{max, number}} players
validation.inviteLink: That doesn't look like an invite link

lineup.title: Lineup
lineup.description: Fill in the match and the players, then download the lineup sheet as PDF or DOCX. Nothing is saved.
lineup.slowPdf: Generating the PDF — the first one after a break takes a bit longer.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Lineup
onboarding.intro: You're not in a team yet. Create your team to start, or join one you've been invited to.
onboarding.createDescription: A team is your club's shared workspace: its roster and saved lineups. You become its owner.
onboarding.joinDescription: Open the link your team owner sent you, or paste it here.

form.listInDirectory: List the team name in the opponent directory
form.listInDirectoryHint: Other teams can then pick you as an opponent. Only the name is shown, never your roster or lineups. You can change this later.

teamSettings.title: Team settings
teamSettings.description: Rename the team or change whether other teams can find it. Only the owner sees this.
teamSettings.listInDirectoryHint: Other teams can then pick you as an opponent. Only the name is shown, never your roster or lineups.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: That address doesn't match anything here.

roster.title: Roster
roster.description: The players of {{team}}. Everyone in the team sees and edits the same roster.

saved.title: Saved lineups
saved.description: Browse, preview and re-generate the lineups you saved.

members.title: Team
members.description: Everyone in {{team}} sees and edits the same roster and saved lineups.
members.lastOwner: You are the only owner. Make someone else the owner before you leave.

players.title: Players
players.description: Everyone in the team can add, edit and delete players. Only a name and an NSSZ number are stored for each.
players.empty: No players yet. Add the first one above.
players.deleteHint: Deleting a player does not change lineups you have already saved: they keep their own copy of the name and NSSZ number.

invites.title: Invite people
invites.description: Anyone who opens the link and signs in with Google joins as a member and sees your roster. Send it only to people who should.
invites.shownOnce: Copy it now: it is shown only here, only once. It stops working on {{date}}.
invites.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it by hand.

join.title: Join {{team}}?
join.invitedByUnknown: You've been invited to this team.
join.signIn: Sign in with Google to join
join.unknownBody: Check that you copied the whole link, or ask the team owner to send it again.
join.goneTitle: This invite link no longer works
join.goneBody: It has expired or was revoked. Ask the team owner for a new link.

directory.title: Opponent directory
directory.hint: Only the names of teams that chose to be listed appear here. You can still type any other opponent's name when you make a lineup.
directory.more: Showing the first {{count}} teams. Type a name to narrow the list.

preview.title: Preview
preview.unreadable: The preview could not be shown. You can still download the file.

creator.description: Build the lineup for {{team}} from the roster, preview the sheet and save it for later.
creator.emptyRoster: The roster is empty. Add players on the Roster page, or type players in by hand.
creator.saved: Saved. You can download it now.

savedLineups.empty: No saved lineups yet. Make a lineup on the Lineup page and save it; it shows up here.
savedLineups.gone: This lineup no longer exists; another member may have deleted it. The list has been refreshed.
